title: Have an LLM Write Your Anomaly Detector: Autonomous Discovery of Compact, Interpretable Detectors for Time Series

claim.summary: An LLM-driven autonomous research loop repeatedly edits one NumPy anomaly-detector program, scores each edit on synthetic anomalies injected into a held-out slice of the training region, and returns the best-scoring compact detector.

modules.name: Detector-program edit-and-evaluate loop
modules.scope_reason: The agent may edit only a fixed-signature program that returns per-timestep anomaly scores and is selected by an anomaly validation score, so the contributed instantiation of the borrowed loop is tied to the detector output contract.
